programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution
programme.desc: Humankind's influence on other species is closely examined to reveal why dogs became one of our closest companions and why our ancestors began to ride horses, and emphasis is placed on how ensuring humankind's survival can mean helping other species.

programme.title: Stormborn
programme.desc: Spring arrives in the lands of the North, and as the weather begins to change, so too do the movements of the animals who call the northern edges of Scotland, Iceland, and Norway home. Narrated by award-winning actor Ewan McGregor, we follow the creatures as they wake from "the great darkness" and face the challenges ahead, from an Arctic fox searching for his mate after a long hibernation to a mother otter desperate to keep her new family together to a large reindeer migration battling through a blizzard to find a place to give birth.

programme.title: Stormborn
programme.desc: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

programme.title: Wild Science
programme.desc: Misunderstood, unpredictable, deadly. Get up close with the hippo as rival males clash, crushing jaws snap and new life emerges beneath the water's surface.

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.desc: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.desc: Head to America’s far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

programme.title: Gangs Of Lemur Island
programme.desc: Over the last four months, the ringtail lemurs of Berenty have endured heat, drought, and only sporadic rain. The early return of the dry heat has thrown the reserve into chaos and turned daily routines upside down. Troops are ignoring boundaries, raiding territories, and grabbing all the fruit they can find before it disappears. Witness the turmoil up-close as fractures emerge within the ranks and divide the troops, leading the queens, especially Crystal of the Ruins Gang, to face challenges like none before.

programme.title: Cub Camp
programme.desc: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

The early return of the dry heat has thrown the reserve into chaos and turned daily routines upside down. Troops are ignoring boundaries, raiding territories, and grabbing all the fruit they can find before it disappears. Witness the turmoil up-close as fractures emerge within the ranks and divide the troops, leading the queens, especially Crystal of the Ruins Gang, to face challenges like none before.

programme.title: Cub Camp
programme.desc: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Stormborn
programme.desc: Spring arrives in the lands of the North, and as the weather begins to change, so too do the movements of the animals who call the northern edges of Scotland, Iceland, and Norway home. Narrated by award-winning actor Ewan McGregor, we follow the creatures as they wake from "the great darkness" and face the challenges ahead, from an Arctic fox searching for his mate after a long hibernation to a mother otter desperate to keep her new family together to a large reindeer migration battling through a blizzard to find a place to give birth.

programme.title: Stormborn
programme.desc: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

programme.title: Carpathian Predators
programme.desc: In the Carpathian mountains lives one of nature's most misunderstood creatures: the Eurasian wolf. See the role these wolves play in the area. (2 of 2)

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.desc: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.desc: Head to America’s far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution
programme.desc: Details are shared about animal species that developed significant changes through evolution, including clownfish that can switch genders, male seahorses that carry their young, and snakes that still have parts of their leg bones.

programme.title: Wild Science
programme.desc: Ancient. Adaptable. Unstoppable. Follow the caiman's journey from the age of dinosaurs to today, where strange symbiosis and fierce maternal instincts shape its survival.

programme.title: Macro Worlds
programme.desc: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the world’s animals are beetles. They have conquered almost every corner and every habitat on the planet and they have survived every global disaster. What is it that makes them so successful?

programme.title: Arabian Seas
programme.desc: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild
programme.desc: The Wild Coast of South Africa stretches for 170 miles. Here, the waters of the Indian and the Atlantic converge, forcing powerful waves towards the shoreline. This is where the Mozambique-based manta ray researcher Andrea Marshall hopes to conduct her first-ever manta ray expedition within South Africa’s borders...

programme.desc: Relive the most jaw-dropping highlights from Part 1 of the 2025 Monster Jam season compilation, featuring elite athletes pushing their machines to the limit in iconic arenas from Greensboro to Chicagoland. programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Jaya, city of gold in the sky! Head for god's shrine!
programme.desc: While the Shandorians continue their battle for control of Upper Yard, the Straw Hats celebrate their happy reunion by swapping stories over a campfire and feasting on barbequed Skyshark!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Festival on the night before gold-hunting! Feelings for vearth!
programme.desc: Laki’s pursuit of precious Vearth causes one of her Shandorian comrades to be injured during the battle with Ohm. As night falls on Upper Yard, the Straw Hats dream of gold while dancing with wolves!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Enter god eneru!! Farewell to the survivors!
programme.desc: The electrifying deity of Skypiea, God Eneru, grants his priests unlimited power in their hunt for the Straw Hats. Usopp has a plan to get the mysteriously-repaired Going Merry back in the water, but it involves using Chopper as bait!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A giant snake bares its fangs! The survival game begins!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats scatter when their search for gold uncovers a giant python, and Gan Fall reveals the tragic story of Jaya’s arrival in the sky. Meanwhile, Wyper readies the Shandorians for a raid on Eneru’s shrine!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The deadly reject! War demon wyper's resolve!
programme.desc: As the heartless god of Upper Yard eagerly anticipates the dawning of Sky Warefare, the Shandorian forces are savagely snared by the Ordeal of String, and Luffy wanders into the fight of his life!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Fierce midair battle! Pirate zoro vs. Warrior braham!
programme.desc: Zoro rushes to perfect a deadly technique known as the Flying Blade Attack. The move proves difficult to master, but it could be the key to the swordsman surviving a battle with the Shandorian warrior, Braham.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The roaring burn bazooka! Luffy vs. War demon wyper!
programme.desc: Sanji and Usopp are driven to their knees by the electrifying presence of god, Luffy is nearly incinerated by Wyper’s Burn Bazooka, and Nami joins Gan Fall in a fight against two killer clones!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The ordeal of the swamp! Chopper vs. Sky punk gedatsu!
programme.desc: Chopper unleashes the fury of his Rumble Ball during a sticky slugfest with a swap cloud spewing priest of Upper Yard. Can the little reindeer discover his opponent’s lone weakness before it’s too late?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Unbeatable powers! Eneru's true form is revealed!
programme.desc: Nami and the Knight of the Sky team up to obliterate two bumbling, balloon-shaped bad guys, and God Eneru relies on his astounding invincibility to torment a noble Shandorian warrior.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A mystical city! The grand ruins of shandora!
programme.desc: Robin’s search for a mystical city of gold is interrupted by Yama, one of Eneru’s faithful servants. When the rampaging warrior destroys some ancient ruins, he provokes the wrath of Robin’s many fists of fury!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: 0% survival rate! Chopper vs. Ohm, the sword wielding priest!
programme.desc: Priest Ohm silences Chopper with an attack from which few – if any – ever recover. Meanwhile, Luffy begins to notice something strange about his cave-like prison, and four fearsome warriors prepare for battle!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Climb giant jack! Deadly combat in the upper ruins!
programme.desc: Zoro, Gan Fall, Wyper, Ohm, and a prizefighting pooch gather for a ferocious free-for-all at the site of the Upper Ruins. While the battle rages, Luffy tries to punch his way out of the belly of a poisonous python!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The ordeal of iron! White barbed death match!
programme.desc: Zoro and Wyper are out to beat down the same bad guys, but will they realize it soon enough to survive a white-barbed death match of doom? Deep in the belly of the python, Nami and Luffy enjoy what could be a short-lived reunion!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Eager to end their battle, Zoro aims the awesome destructive power of his 108 Caliber Phoenix at the sinister Priest Ohm! Elsewhere, god demands that Robin help him search for a legendary golden bell.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Collapsing upper ruins! The quintet for the finale!
programme.desc: God Eneru begins a deadly rampage aimed at exterminating the heavenly beings of Skypiea, and the ruins of Shandora become the scene of a bloody contest where survival is the name of the game.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Showdown in the ancient ruins! Sky god eneru's goal!
programme.desc: Gan Fall, Wyper, Zoro, and Robin join forces for an attack on God Eneru. Despite their furious onslaught, the four warriors prove powerless to harm the thunderous deity until Wyper utilizes the power of a mystical stone!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Ambition toward the endless vearth! The ark maxim!
programme.desc: God Eneru makes a shocking recovery from wounds that should have ended his reign of terror. Zoro and Wyper muster the strength for one final stand, and Nami must choose between her friends – and survival.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: They finally clash! Pirate luffy vs. God eneru!
programme.desc: Luffy emerges from his serpentine tomb with one thing on his mind: revenge! As the rubber-man sets out to settle the score with God Eneru, Conis rushes to warn her people of their impending doom!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the citizens of the sky run for their lives, Eneru issues in the dawn of Deathpiea! Luffy is determined to stop the madman, but first he must discover a way to lay hands on the heinous holy man!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy falls! Eneru's judgement and nami's wish!
programme.desc: A handful of gold sends Luffy hurtling towards his death, Sanji and Usopp mount a midair rescue mission, and Nami prepares for an electrifying showdown with God Eneru!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The two awaken! On the front lines of the burning love rescue!
programme.desc: Usopp arrives just in time to save Nami from a lethal thunderbolt, but even their combined powers are no match for Eneru. While they scramble for an escape route, Sanji stealthily searches for a way to sabotage god’s ark!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Capriccio for despair! The impending doom of sky island!
programme.desc: Despite being slowed by an arm encased in gold, Luffy races up a giant beanstalk on a mission to settle the score with Eneru! Elsewhere, the people of Skypiea feel the jolt of god’s wrath!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Led by a bell's sound! Tale of the great warrior and the explorer!
programme.desc: A flashback offers a glimpse at the lives of two legendary figures in Skypiea’s history: Montblanc Noland and the ferocious warrior Kalgara!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Free from the spell! The great warrior sheds tears!
programme.desc: The look back at the legend of Montblanc Noland and Kalgara the warrior continues with the story of how these two very different men suddenly found friendship – and then lost it just as quickly!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Eternal friends! The vowed bell echoes across the mighty seas!
programme.desc: Montblanc Noland and the warrior Kalgara succeed in settling their difference before parting ways, but the laws of nature and man conspire to keep them apart – permanently!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Angel island obliterated! The horror of the raigo's advent!
programme.desc: Eneru strikes Angel Island with a devastating lightning bolt, and Luffy continues his heroic climb up the giant beanstalk. The rubber-man refuses to stop until he rings the golden bell – no matter what the cost!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Knock over giant jack! Last hope for escape!
programme.desc: While Eneru continues his thunderous barrage, Nami hatches a plan to give Luffy one more shot at a grudge match with god. Zoro’s at the center of the scheme, but he might not survive his mission!

programme.title: On the Case: Murder in Room 205
programme.desc: A young woman's journey to a new life comes to a savage end in a roadside motel.

programme.title: On the Case: Kidnapped on the 4th of July
programme.desc: When a young woman's pizza delivery car is found abandoned in the middle of the desolate stretch of road, a twenty three year mystery begins.

programme.title: On the Case: Cali-Doe
programme.desc: A young girl is murdered in Caledonia New York, and police struggle to identify her. The tragedy leads the town make her one of their own, with the name Cali-Doe.

programme.title: On the Case: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A new father comes home to find his infant son and wife missing. Four months later their bodies are found in a remote wooded area. When police investigate the father's past they find the reason for the unthinkable crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Paper Trail
programme.desc: The police follow a trail of emails, hoping it will lead them to a 38-year-old woman's vicious killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Left in the Dark
programme.desc: When a beautiful young graduate student is found stabbed to death, detectives must determine if the murder was a crime of passion or a brutal attack by a violent intruder.

programme.title: On the Case: A Slip of Fate
programme.desc: A woman is found clinging to the guardrail of a steep embankment. She tells police a harrowing story; two men had attacked her and her husband at gunpoint and now he is missing. Was it a robbery gone wrong or part of a far more sinister plot?

programme.title: On the Case: Devil in a Cowboy Hat
programme.desc: A young woman is found bound and strangled to death on the side of a road. As police retrace her final steps, they discover she was last seen being followed by a suspicious man in a cowboy hat.

programme.title: On the Case: Twice Is No Accident
programme.desc: When Fran Smith mysteriously disappears her sister and daughter mount their own investigation... What they uncover sends police on a cross country man hunt for a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Twisted Lies
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, 41-year-old Nancy Menke, a mother of four, is found handcuffed and murdered in the passenger seat of her car; a records clerk in the insurance fraud unit stumbles upon a strange report that blows open Menke's murder case.

programme.title: On the Case: In the Blink of an Eye
programme.sub-title: In the Blink of an Eye
programme.desc: November 21, 1988, Sheriff's deputies received an alarming phone call from a convenience store in Leesville, Louisiana. A delivery person said the clerk who signs for deliveries was missing and the store's cash register was open and empty

programme.title: On the Case: Unthinkable Harm
programme.desc: When a teenager is found savagely stabbed to death in her home, police hope a trail of blood found at the crime scene will lead them to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Dance
programme.desc: A woman's walk home from a night out at a dance club ends in a brutal murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Long Sought Truth
programme.desc: Sunday December 3rd, 1978. A motorist walked into the empty office of a Palmdale, California gas station and stumbled upon the aftermath of a violent robbery. Even more chilling was the fact that station's attendant was nowhere to be found.

programme.title: On the Case: A Different Time
programme.desc: When Barbara Rowan left her house on an afternoon in 1984, she had a baseball mitt, a ball and a radio. Barbara claimed she was on her way to meet her coach. After she didn't return home, Police discovered that the teenager didn't play any sports.

Un Milagro en Texas
programme.desc: Un Milagro en Texas es una comedia desternillante que se desarrolla en el corazón de la Gran Depresión. John Ratzenberger y Kevin Sorbo brillan interpretando a dos astutos estafadores que urden un plan para conquistar a viudas y convencerlas de invertir en sus aparentemente inútiles empresas de pozos de petróleo. Las risas no se hacen esperar mientras las viudas luchan con sus decisiones, solo para que la situación se invierta cuando un giro inesperado del destino conduce a un auténtico hallazgo de petróleo.

programme.title: Hemingway
programme.desc: Tras la muerte del propietario del imperio editorial Hemingway, su familia está interesada en su herencia. Sin embargo, rápidamente se enteran de una estipulación en el testamento: deben dejar de lado sus problemas y reparar la brecha que los divide en 8 horas, o no heredarán nada.

programme.title: Citas Letales
programme.desc: Sharon Siermans, de 29 años, estaba buscando el amor cuando comenzó a chatear online con un hombre llamado Jason Godfrey. Acordaron su primera cita, pero cuando Sharon lo conoció en la estación de tren, no se parecía en nada a lo que era.

programme.desc: Una estrella de telerrealidad deja L. A. y se dirige a territorio Amish, donde descubrirá una nueva realidad.

programme.title: Amo La Cocina
programme.desc: Después de una mala crítica de un crítico y una charla del chef Gordon Ramsay, un chef londinense talentoso pero afligido convierte un pub rural en un restaurante gourmet. Su postre llama la atención (y el sabor) de Kate, y pronto descubren que la receta para la verdadera felicidad es una pizca de trabajo en equipo y mucho amor.

programme.title: Un Romance Escurridizo
programme.desc: Una estrella de telerrealidad deja L. A. y se dirige a territorio Amish, donde descubrirá una nueva realidad.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una emprendedora amigable y su hijo abordan un crucero para unas vacaciones lejos de sus preocupaciones cuando de repente ella desaparece. ¿Sus problemas financieros se apoderaron de ella? ¿O hay alguien a bordo que la haya asesinado?

programme.title: Por el Amor de George
programme.desc: Una esposa abandonada deja a su marido y viaja a Los Ángeles en busca del hombre de sus sueños: George Clooney, ¡y se detendrá ante todo para conocerlo!

programme.title: Paso Decisivo
programme.desc: Una joven, que no está satisfecha con el rumbo de su vida, visita a una prima suya durante el verano. En estos meses se expone a otro mundo, encuentra la amistad y mucho más. Pronto deberá elegir y asimilar la vida que quiere.

programme.title: 5 Bodas
programme.desc: Una periodista que escribe una historia sobre bodas en Punjabi se enamora de su oficial de enlace, quien intenta mantener su historia censurada en medio de un colorido mosaico de bailarines transgénero y choques culturales.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Mientras el Dr. Blunt realiza un experimento de telepatía con una chinchilla, que deja su mente temporalmente atrapada en el cuerpo del animal, el Equipo Astro investiga los misterios del teatro "embrujado". Suzu sube al escenario y canta. ¡Ay! Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. El Equipo Astro apaga el fuego y salva el teatro y, para sorpresa de todos, la canción de Derek le consigue una pareja.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo retoma el contrabando de las esmeraldas engañando a Esperanza para drogarla y violarla. Al otro día, Ricardo decide regresar con ella. Horas más tarde, Alcides pone una bomba en el carro de los militares en que Olga se sube por casualidad, aunque su exesposo intenta impedirlo, la bomba estalla dejándola en estado crítico.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: El atentado deja muy afectado a Eduardo, haciendo que despida a Alcides, también descubre que él los robaba. Días después, Rubén gana la alcaldía del pueblo de forma deshonesta. Por otra parte, el Padre Javier regresa para ver a Olga.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Reina y Esmeralda por fin encuentra piedras en la mina, que suponía estaba ya seca. Por otra parte, Adelaida le tiende una trampa a Eduardo, junto a Alcira para vengarse. Más tarde, Reina encuentra a Verónica y a Octavio en la cama, enfurecida les prohíbe continuar con ese tipo de relación. Al mismo tiempo, el Padre Javier retorna para denunciar a Alcides.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Octavio encuentra a su padre. Días después, Eduardo llega para atormentar a Esperanza, contándole toda la verdad a Ricardo, por la cual la abandona. Finalmente, se revelan las extorsiones que llevaron a Rubén a la alcaldía, en consecuencia este es destituido.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Esmeralda descubre que Ricardo y Esperanza esperan un hijo y llora creyendo que él no la amaba. El periodista Salcedo publica la renuncia del gobernador por chantaje. Eduardo presiona a Adelaida para obtener información sobre Alcira y ordena a Rubén y Octavio encontrarla y traerla, intensificando la tensión en el pueblo.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ricardo va en búsqueda de Esmeralda. Al otro día, Eduardo hace una tregua con los caciques de Quitaque, planeando asesinar a Alejandro, cuando se vuelve Gobernador y empieza a acabar con los corruptos. Por otra parte, Octavio y Verónica inauguran una discoteca.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Finalmente, las mujeres encuentran la mina llena de esmeraldas. En el entierro de Alcides, Eduardo advierte a Alejandro que lo buscan para matarlo, lo que al principio parece querer ayudarlo, él lo entrega a sus enemigos para que lo asesinen, sin embargo, todo es una trampa para deshacerse de sus enemigos, minutos después “El Tigre” traiciona a Eduardo asesinando a Alejandro.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Es un misterio por qué una ancianita está rompiendo reflectores frente a un centro turístico costero recién construido. El equipo pronto descubre que ZARA está tratando de ayudar a las tortugas recién nacidas a llegar desde sus nidos hasta el mar. Pero la confusa contaminación lumínica no es la única amenaza que enfrentan, los depredadores acechan y un derrame de petróleo en el mar las espera. Es una batalla en tres frentes para salvar a las tortugas, pero los niños tienen tres cosas a su favor: superpoderes, gran inteligencia y redes de seda de araña sintética.

programme.title: Tras el Cristal
programme.desc: Durante la II Guerra Mundial, el doctor Klaus torturó, abusó y mató a niños deportados. Un intento de suicidio lo obliga a permanecer conectado a un pulmón de acero. La aparición de un niño que se ofrece a cuidarlo establece una siniestra relación de deseo, venganza y apropiación de personalidad.

programme.title: La forma del bosque
programme.desc: Andrés y Silvia, dos hermanos que viven con su abuelo en una casa en medio del bosque, desatan la ira de una entidad oscura que los perseguirá sin descanso hasta atraparlos, durante el transcurso de una noche. Los niños deben encontrar las debilidades de la entidad para sobrevivir hasta el amanecer y así liberarse de la maldición.

programme.title: Origins of the Universe: The Great Debate
programme.desc: El mundo que nos rodea contiene muchos sistemas complejos que funcionan perfectamente juntos. Durante muchos años ha habido un acalorado debate entre evolución y creación, con la pregunta central de todo: "¿Fue creada la Tierra o llegó a existir por sí sola?" Conozca a siete expertos en sus campos que han dedicado su vida al estudio de esta cuestión.

programme.title: Dog Whisperer with Cesar Millan
programme.desc: French Bulldog Bozley is showing dog aggression and wont let Sean and Nidias guests enter the house without trying to scare them away first. Regina and Steve Risseeuw wanted a high energy dog and adopted a Vizsla named Ginger, but Steve noticed that she was more high strung than high energy.

programme.title: The Wildlife Docs
programme.desc: Three years ago, Kelsey was a vet camper at Busch Gardens Tampa Bay. Today, she's landed her dream job, as a vet tech, assisting The Wildlife Docs. Plus, a red kangaroo goes in for her first checkup while a Western grey needs surgery.

programme.title: The Wildlife Docs
programme.sub-title: Welcome to Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
programme.desc: Meet a pair of tiny tenrecs, the largest species of porcupine, and a tarantula, just three of the newest creatures to call Busch Gardens Tampa Bay home. Plus, a young sloth goes in for a CT scan.

programme.title: The Wildlife Docs
programme.sub-title: Saving Wild Rhinos in South Africa
programme.desc: Dr. Mike joins forces with a South African Wildlife Vet as they work to keep the white rhino population healthy. Plus, meet dedicated conservationists, including a young boy, who are doing their part to help save the iconic black rhino from extinction.

programme.title: The Wildlife Docs
programme.desc: You'll be amazed to see how fast these babies are growing! Lions, lemurs, sloths, flamingos, an orangutan, hyena, wallaby, and a giraffe too!

programme.title: The Wildlife Docs
programme.desc: A 350-pound silverback gorilla and his mom go in for their annual checkups while two young gorillas make the most of playtime.

programme.title: The Wildlife Docs
programme.sub-title: The Fast and Slow of It
programme.desc: Discover what's slowing down a usually fast cheetah. Plus, we'll travel to South Africa to visit with a cheetah rescue and rehab facility. Then, take it slow with two, young Aldabra tortoises.

programme.title: Dr. Chris Pet Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Chris gives a check up to a young cavoodle pup named Cujo. It's important Cujo gets the all clear from Chris so he can be a companion dog during hopsital visits for his owner Declan who has cystic fibrosis. But Chris thinks cheeky Cujo needs some urgent puppy training. And, the team at SASH must help six-month-old labrador Oliver who has been limping for a few weeks. Then, Dr. Chris must help a pregnant cow through a difficult labor.

programme.title: Dr. Chris Pet Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail three-day-old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mother and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. And, Chiko the maltipoo has been rushed in to SASH and Dr. Lisa suspects the little dog may have been attacked by a deadly paralysis tick.

programme.title: Dr. Chris Pet Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Chris heads to the country, and this city vet has his hands full. His patients include Pepper, a pig with pregnancy issues, and a foal who is being rejected by its mother. Then, Dr. Lisa Chimes makes an unexpected discovery as to why a young dog has ulcers on both his eyes.

programme.title: Dr. Chris Pet Vet
programme.desc: Chris is in volunteering in China at one of Beijing's busiest veterinary clinics. His first patient is a hamster with a worrying lump on its chest. Then, Chris must help Eddy who is worried about his bull mastiff. The locals are scared of the big friendly dog. And the finale to Chris's trip is an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Into Thin Air
programme.desc: Jim Donnelly was a hard-working family man living a quiet life in suburban Auckland. For 20 years he’d worked as a scientist at the Glenbrook Steel Mill, south of Auckland. On the 21st of June 2004, he simply vanished into thin air.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: Our new team of “ Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to unmask the killer – or killers – of vivacious New Zealand hairdresser Paula Brown who was plucked from Sydney’s downtown after a night out with friends.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Stone Cold
programme.desc: In 2004, Brendan Percy was found dead of hypothermia and dehydration in a sub alpine area above Oamaru in suspicious circumstances.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: A Bump in the Night
programme.desc: In 1980, six-year-old Alicia O'Reilly was raped and murdered in her bed, while her sister slept less than a metre away, and her mother sleeping across the hallway.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Out of Aces
programme.desc: Garth Doull trained to be a policeman but the lure of the race track saw him swap sides of the law to become a consummate con-man. On the 8th of September 1989, his body was found floating in Wellington harbour.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Lost Soul
programme.desc: In 1985, 25-year-old Luana 'La Verne' Williams disappeared from her Tauranga home. Eight years later her disappearance was upgraged to a murder enquiry. Her body has never been found.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Walk of Innocence
programme.desc: In 1970, eighteen-year-old Olive Waiker disappeared as she walked across Rotorua to babysit her nieces and nephews. Her semi-naked body was found hours later in a rest area south of the city..

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Now You See Me
programme.desc: 26-year-old deaf woman Alexa Cullen vanished from her home in Manaia, on the Coromandel Peninsular in 1995. She had a history of hitch-hiking and police suspected she’d run away. But three years later, ominous rumors began circulating in the community.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Sensing Murder Insights - Special
programme.desc: Police detectives from around New Zealand reveal exciting new developments sparked by the Sensing Murder psychics in Series 1.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Girl in The Ditch
programme.desc: When 12 year old Agnes Ali'iva'a drowned in a ditch in 1992, the police initially thought her death was accidental. It was four years before public and political pressure forced police to re-investigate her death.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: “Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to connect with the spirit of murdered Christchurch scrap-metal dealer, John Reynolds, to discover his killer and reveal the truth surrounding the violent attack.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Seeking Siegfried
programme.desc: Katikati man Siegfried Newman disappeared on February 25, 2008, after he had dropped his sons Thomas, 9, and Oliver, 7, at Pahoia School. Police carried out a three-day search but found no sign of him.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland
programme.desc: Flying Over Iceland: Part I is a stunning yet soothing aerial journey to the remote fjiords and valleys of eastern Iceland. The first of a series of 1 hour films, Part I begins at sunrise on a perfect summer day in Breiðdalsvík, where a golden sun lights up the majestic valley. After soaring through the golden sea mists and offering a glimpse of the stunning Breiðdalur Valley (its name means ‘Wide Valley’), viewers then head inland to a hidden, magical arched waterfall for a refreshing immersive flight that begins at the base of the falls and reaches above the clouds. Next, as the morning turns into a sunlit afternoon, viewers are swept inland to the crystal clear waters of the the impressive Breiðdalsá river, to cool off in some falls along with a pair of local swans. Well known for salmon fishing, the turquoise blue river winds its way scenically across the valley basin to the sea, which is where the film ends - but not before a chance encounter with a local reindeer! The final flight in Part 1 offers a sunny afternoon look at the tiny village of Breiðdalsvík from afar and offers amazing blue water vistas of with green islands, seagulls, a rock island that that looks like a cat, a scenic lighthouse, and more.

Joel Joan, en horas bajas, sueña con este papel, pero Nico Carrillo, director de la película, detesta profundamente a Joel. Nico sólo le dará el papel a cambio de una condición. ¿Qué precio será capaz de pagar a Joel para conseguir el papel de su vida?

programme.title: El Crac
programme.desc: Joel intenta por todos los medios que Roger Coma, a quien han dado el papel de Moragues, se dedique a escribir y abandone la película. Y mientras los actores entrenan para el rodaje que les espera, Joel, rabioso y herido en el orgullo por haber perdido el papel protagonista, convierte el entrenamiento en una competición personal con Roger. Paralelamente, Crac intenta recuperar su relación sentimental con Sandra.

programme.title: La Renaixença
programme.desc: El último capítulo de "La Renaixença" de esta primera semana lo dedicamos a la aspiradora. Un objeto que nació con todos los eres y manos del machismo, y que a día de hoy se ha convertido en casi en una nave espacial. Nunca estaremos tan cerca de Julia Roberts como hoy, porque charlamos con Mercè Montalà, su dobladora. ¿Sabía que "Pretty Woman" no está doblada al catalán? Hoy lo arreglamos. Y no nos olvidemos de nuestra pequeña radionovela: salimos a pasear al perro por la batalla de Stalingrado.

programme.title: Les Feres
programme.desc: Con la gira "A revivir", la formación manresana cerró con una decena de conciertos especiales una trayectoria de 30 años. El quinteto catalán ha destacado a lo largo de su carrera por cultivar un pop-rock basado en las armonías vocales de sus componentes, con un repertorio en el que abordan las relaciones sentimentales, las reflexiones personales y, también, la crítica social. Y con canciones tan emblemáticas como el sencillo "Corren", grabada originalmente con la colaboración del músico barcelonés Dani Macaco.

programme.title: La Renaixença
programme.desc: La primera semana de programa siempre es especial recordarla, por eso os dejamos un resumen con algunos de los mejores momentos que hemos vivido durante estos días. O si los ha visto todos y desea recordar algunos momentos, los encontrará aquí. Es ese capítulo que hace gracia porque ponemos lo mejor, pero que te deja con ganas de más porque no está todo.

programme.title: Grizzy y los Lemmings
programme.sub-title: La batalla per la corona sagrada
programme.desc: Grizzy y los Lémmings tienen un juego nuevo: se disputan una corona que deben colocar sobre la cabeza de un peluche que es como ellos: un osito y un roedor. Después de un primer enfrentamiento épico, Grizzy consigue la corona, pero se le rompe el peluche. Cuando echa a los Lémmings, intenta repararlo. Mientras, los Lémmings descubren una fábrica de peluches que podría permitirles recuperar la corona y ganar la partida.

programme.title: Grizzy y los Lemmings
programme.desc: Los Lémmings encuentran un extraño juego de cartas que representa a los elementos, junto con unas instrucciones. La idea es fingir que el suelo arde o que está cubierto de hielo, al igual que en el juego "El suelo es lava". Transforman la cabaña en una gigantesca pista de aventuras y, según las cartas que sacan, deben evitar pisar las zonas del suelo donde están dibujadas las llamas o que están cubiertas de cera. Grizzy les desmonta el juego para recuperar el control de la cabaña, pero entonces una de las cartas cae sobre una losa de piedra y se convierte en lava. Los Lémmings están encantados: ¡ahora podrán jugar "de verdad"!

programme.title: Grizzy y los Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy y los Lémmings vuelven a pelearse y acaban provocándole un accidente en el trineo de Papá Noel. Los roedores acuden al lugar del incidente y se apropian de su buzón mágico. Mientras Grizzy asea la cabaña después de la pelea, se sorprende cuando ve a los Lémmings volver tranquilos y en silencio. Los roedores le cantan villancicos y le preparan un delicioso aperitivo antes de irse. Grizzy no se fía y decide seguirlos. Entonces descubre que el buzón recompensa a aquellos que tienen deseos que equivalen a su bondad.

programme.title: Colegas en el bosque
programme.desc: Roger Allers, director de clásicos como 'La bella y la bestia' (1991) o 'El rey león' (1994), dirige junto a Jill Culton y Anthony Stacchi esta divertida película de animación cuyo tema principal es la ayuda entre animales cuando la caza amenaza. Boog es un oso pardo que vive cómodo y sin preocupaciones en el pueblo desde que Beth, su cuidadora, le acogió. Cierto día, Boog conoce a Elliot, un ciervo muy hablador al que le falta un cuerno tras haber sido víctima de un cazador... Tras ayudar a Elliot y a tan sólo dos días de que comience la temporada de caza, Boog se sumerge en el bosque junto con su amigo el ciervo para ayudar a los demás animales a evitar el ataque de los cazadores. En su doblaje al español, la voz de Boog, pertenece al actor y humorista cubano Alexis Valdés. La voz de Elliot, el ciervo, es la de Pepe Viyuela, conocido por su papel de Chema en la serie 'Aída'. Tres años después del estreno, en 2009, se lanza la segunda parte de esta divertida película de animación.

programme.title: Asterix el galo
programme.desc: En el año 50 a.c. los ejércitos romanos han ocupado toda la Galia. Sin embargo, un pequeño pueblecito galo resiste los ataques de los invasores. Cuatro campamentos romanos rodean la aldea en espera de la ocasion que les permita dominarles. Los habitantes del poblado basan su increíble fuerza en una poción mágica que prepara el druida Panarámix. Cuando los invasores se enteran de la existencia de esta poción, secuestran al mago. Astérix, con su astucia, y Obélix, que tiene perennes los efectos de la poción mágica, son los encargados de rescatarle.

programme.title: La Renaixença
programme.desc: Iniciamos la segunda semana de "La Renaixença" hablando sobre los calcetines. ¿Quién no ha perdido un calcetín en el tiempo que pasa entre que te lo quitas hasta que lo extiendes después de la lavadora? ¿Dónde han ido a parar todos estos calcetines? Lo intentamos descubrir. Hablamos con Manel Alías, que no quiere que se le recuerde como el corresponsal que cubrió la guerra de Rusia y Ucrania. Le hemos pedido que nos explique cómo quiere que le recordemos. Acabamos el programa paseando en Crus Baldiri, un perro de Sabadell, por la compra de Manhattan por 24 dólares.

programme.title: Los Pitufos 3D
programme.sub-title: El barrufet que va perdre l'ombra
programme.desc: T3 - 48 El Periodista está haciendo un reportaje fotográfico en el Forçut y, cuando se le acaba el flash, toma unos polvos del laboratorio del Gran Barrufet para cargarlo. Pero se equivoca de bote y el flash provoca que la sombra del Forçut cobre vida propia y se independice. La sombra está cansada de realizar siempre ejercicio y quiere probar cosas nuevas. Pero vivir separados puede tener nefastas consecuencias tanto para la sombra como para el Forçut.

programme.title: Los Pitufos 3D
programme.desc: T3 - 49 Gargamel captura a Barrutempesta y Gran Barrufet y encanta a la muñeca de Rowena, Lucrecia, para que les haga de implacable carcelera. A cambio de la libertad, el Gran Pitufo se alía con el Gargamel para conseguir los polvos mágicos y el libro que necesita el hechicero para revertir el hechizo.

programme.desc: InfoK es el primer y único informativo pensado para niños de todo el estado. Se emite en directo, de lunes a jueves, a las 19.30h, por el X3, el canal infantil de Televisió de Catalunya. Va dirigido a cualquier persona que esté interesada en conocer mejor la actualidad, aunque, en principio, está pensado para que le miren niños y niñas de entre 8 y 12 años. Seguimos el horario escolar, es decir que, cuando las escuelas no dan clase, el InfoK no se emite. Por ejemplo, durante las vacaciones de verano, Semana Santa o Navidad.

programme.title: La Renaixença
programme.desc: Hablamos del despertador, de largo, el utensilio doméstico que más rabia da. Hay que ser muy desgraciado para que te guste que un trasto de éstos te despiertan con ese maldito ruido. Tenemos a un espeleólogo con nosotros, Víctor Ferrer. Le preguntamos qué le empuja a joderse en todas las cuevas que encuentra, porque de salida nos parece un poco raro. Y paseamos al perro por la invención del cronómetro marino. Sí, de primera parece una mierda de historia, pero os prometemos que es más interesante de lo que aparenta.

programme.title: Xefs: noves generacions
programme.desc: Martina Puigvert lidera la cocina de Les Cols, donde asume el relevo generacional con sus dos hermanas, dando continuidad y evolución a uno de los proyectos gastronómicos más singulares del país. Hija de Fina Puigdevall, ha sabido refinar una cocina radicalmente garrochina, basada en el producto de proximidad y de temporada, sin romper el ADN de la casa. Formada en el Basque Culinary Center y con experiencias en cocinas de alta exigencia como el Koy Shunka, aporta rigor, método y una visión contemporánea en el restaurante, lo que le ha llevado a recibir el Premio Michelin al Mejor Chef Joven.

programme.title: Xefs: noves generacions
programme.desc: La vida de Ivan Surinder cambió radicalmente el 19 de octubre de 2011 con la muerte súbita de su padre, uno de los cocineros indios más relevantes en Barcelona. Esto le obligó, con sólo 19 años, a asumir un restaurante familiar sin tener ninguna noción de cocina. Ante la urgencia, se formó a contrarreloj y dio un salto decisivo a Tickets, con Albert Adrià, donde aprendió organización, disciplina y rigor. Hoy lidera Tandoor con una visión contemporánea: una cocina india respetuosa con su raíz, adaptada al paladar catalán sin renunciar a la identidad ni al legado de su padre.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Leandro sigue a Jimena y descubre quién es su enamorado, él se divierte cuando su prometida se molesta. La llegada de Ruth, la hija de Raquel, paraliza la celebración del compromiso.

programme.title: Hermanitas calle
programme.desc: La familia se apellida Calle. Son 4 hermanas, 1 hermano, la mamá, un tío y los novios. Dos de las hermanas son cantantes populares y consiguen un contrato discográfico, pero todos los miembros de la familia, incluyéndolas, atraviesan situaciones dramáticas. Tienen que enfrentar muchos problemas que no dejan de aparecer. Las dos protagonistas son las hermanas cantantes. Además, deben enfrentarse al alcalde corrupto y malvado, quien acusa falsamente a una de ellas y hace que termine en la cárcel.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Du Plessis is restless after his heart surgery but the family insist he needs to relax. Meanwhile Danny and Alice are happy to have closed down a zoo down that has been mistreating animals.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: While on honeymoon in London, Alice discovers that Danny has some final business to do before they can return home to Africa. He's reluctantly arranged to meet his estranged father, Robert, who has recently got back in touch.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny is throwing himself into his work after the death of his father, and has applied for the role of State Vet. However, Danny's attempts to involve Thabo in the first phase of the Lion Breeding Project lead to Du Plessis feeling like an outsider.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: It is Danny's first day as State Vet and when he helps rescue some smuggled animals he feels he's making a difference. However, he discovers the role isn't going to be all plain sailing.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny's first big project as State Vet is a major animal translocation, and he is desperate to impress. Meanwhile, whilst Alice is out in the bush treating an injured zebra, she is stalked by lions. She makes it back to her jeep in time but is shaken up.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Alice is still suffering from a loss of nerve after her close shave with the lions and so Danny tries to help her overcome her problems – the Leopard's Den lions have produced their first cub and he needs Alice back in the saddle.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: In his role as State Vet, Danny works with wealthy conservationist, Anton Ziegler, to catch a group of leopard hunters. Ziegler is also buying a tiger from Vanessa, who struggling with her finances, desperately needs the money to ensure Mara's future.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Du Plessis has started a one man campaign of vandalism against the new neighbours at Mara; Peeters and the mining company. When Peeters catches him on CCTV, Du Plessis is fined and given a restraining order to keep him away from Mara.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Du Plessis comes to meet Caroline's plane but he doesn't seem happy – he has seen that the mining company have already started building the road which threatens Leopard's Den.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: The family are making arrangements to leave Leopard's Den, all except Du Plessis who is steadfastly refusing to accept that he has lost his home. He won't use his share of the money from the sale of the land to buy somewhere else.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: The family have been squatting at Leopard's Den as they prepare to make their last stand to prevent the bulldozers from destroying their home. Du Plessis and Fatani bring elephants and a giraffe to dissuade the construction crew from moving in.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: After the devastating loss of Leopard's Den, the family are split across continents. Caroline, Liv and a heavily pregnant Alice are in the UK, while Danny and Du Plessis have remained in South Africa.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny returns to South Africa with Caroline, Liv and Charlotte. They are all excited to be back and are looking forward to seeing their new home, Clearwater Farm.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny has been preparing his pitch for an Endangered Species Project. JLW, a pharmaceutical company, are looking to fund an environmental project and the family hope that this grant money will enable them to buy Leopard's Den and Mara.
